blurb: The East Hawaiʻi Cultural Center is a non-profit organization supporting the arts and culture community in Hilo for over 50 years. It is located across from Kalākaua Park in beautiful historic Downtown Hilo; a two-block walk from Hilo’s downtown Bayfront.
